rubric_source: Official organizer event page, verified 25 October 2026: https://luma.com/nightshift-london

criteria.claim: A reviewed synthetic conversational correction reached kept data and a completed training job.
limitations: Fresh live trained-adapter inference is blocked.

criteria.claim: The text game implements recurring conversational-response generation and believability-feedback collection; the intended downstream users are voice-agent builders.
limitations: Voice-agent integration and spoken-dialogue transfer are unverified.
Customer demand, reply-quality gains and latency gains have not been measured.
Human/AI votes are conversation-level believability signals, not guaranteed per-reply quality labels.
Human-authored training-target ingestion is not implemented. Optional transcript permission is separate from vote feedback; external captures and ratings are disabled.
Synthetic operator-reviewed examples are not a user study.

criteria.claim: Released Expo game with animated characters and verified hosted rounds, plus reproducible local backend, client, asset and learning-runner checks.
limitations: Local tests use mocks and do not prove current deployment behavior.
Public-launch safeguards and physical-device verification remain incomplete.
The 40-player/40-room checks use isolated test services and do not measure live provider capacity.

criteria.claim: The main playtest is released, with earlier verified live rounds, diagnostic clients, labelled fixtures and a proposed timed walkthrough.
limitations: No timed presentation rehearsal or validated/uploaded submission video is claimed.
Fresh learned-model serving remains blocked; fixtures and recorded evidence are not live substitutes.
